scope: Timed input traces verify actual combos/guard/punishes and deterministic replays under simulated RTT, jitter, upload/receipt loss and skipped views. Browser trials verify 40 fighters against Chrollo (Chrollo against Hisoka), five isolated light attacks each, two private contexts, one WebGL renderer. RTT shaper adds 100 ms + jitter/application faults. Baseline replaces only the input client with ce85118e while retaining prediction/SSE, engine and rendering. Physical controller-to-photon latency, reactive human hit confirms, two physical machines, real Internet, exhaustive GPU pair/Hatsu load and competitive balance are not measured. Other desktop/benchmark workloads were present; no system power or graphics settings were changed.

deterministicComparison.scope: Production input sender and server referee. Deterministic timed input traces, not reactions to delayed views. Same 20/s + burst budget. Baseline serializes uploads until HTTP receipt; after uses cumulative pipelining. No faults in this timing comparison; the separate 1600-case regression adds upload/receipt loss and skipped views. RTT is simulated. No rendering or physical input latency is measured here.
